name: personal-os
install:
export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"
command -v bun >/dev/null || curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"
sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -qq
sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq postgresql postgresql-contrib openssl >/dev/null
bun install
start:
export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"
if [ -f scripts/ensure-postgres.sh ]; then bash scripts/ensure-postgres.sh; else sudo service postgresql start || true; PGPASSWORD=password psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U postgres -d postgres -tc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='personal-os'" | grep -q 1 || PGPASSWORD=password psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U postgres -d postgres -c 'CREATE DATABASE "personal-os";'; fi
if [ -f scripts/cloud-materialize-env.sh ]; then bash scripts/cloud-materialize-env.sh; fi
(cd packages/db && DATABASE_URL="${DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://postgres:password@127.0.0.1:5432/personal-os}" bun x drizzle-kit push --force)
bun run dev
